description: Given a credential you have already found, checks whether it still authenticates by making a single read-only identity request to the provider that issued it (OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Google, or a Supabase service_role JWT). Non-billable and non-mutating: no model calls, no writes. Use this to tell a real incident from an already-rotated key before alarming the user. The credential is sent only to its own issuer.

credential.description: The raw credential value to check.

kind.description: Credential type if known, e.g. 'OpenAI API key', 'Stripe live secret key', 'GitHub token', 'Supabase service_role key'. Inferred from the value when omitted.

name: flare_verify_credential
title: Check whether a credential is still live
